study type: Case report and limited literature review
cohort: Extremely preterm infants with large ventricular septal defects (VSD), severe chronic lung disease (CLD), and pulmonary hypertension (PH).
finding: The study reports the successful treatment of an extremely preterm infant with pulmonary artery banding followed by VSD closure, and a limited literature review suggests individualized consideration is crucial when choosing between this staged approach and one-stage VSD closure due to variable outcomes and risks.
